chapterInfo.content:
1
Yerusalem sɛeɛ ne n’ahohora
1 # Yer 51.5 Ao, kuro a anka emu nkurɔfoɔ dɔɔso no,
ɔno nko ara te hɔ sɛn nie!
Deɛ anka ɔso amanaman mu no,
wayɛ sɛ okunafoɔ.
Deɛ ɔdi nsase ahodoɔ so hemmaa no,
wayɛ deɛ ɔyi toɔ.
2 # Dwom 69.20 Esu ara na ɔsu anadwo,
na nisuo sensane n’afono ho.
Ɔnnya n’adɔfo nyinaa mu
ɔwerɛkyekyefoɔ biara;
ne mfɛfoɔ nyinaa atwitwa no nkontompo,
wɔadanedane n’atamfoɔ.
3Amaneɛ ne ɛsom dodoɔ nti
Yuda atukɔfoɔ mu.
Ɔte amanaman mu,
nanso ɔnnya homegyebea.
N’atifoɔ nyinaa kɔtoo no
n’ahokyerɛ mu.
4Sion akwan di abooboo,
sɛ obiara mma afahyɛ no ase nti,
n’aponkɛseɛ nyinaa ayɛ afo;
n’asɔfoɔ gu ahome,
ne mmabaa ayɛ mmɔbɔmmɔbɔ,
na ɔno ara nso, ayɛ no nwono.
5N’ahohiahiafoɔ ayɛ akannifoɔ,
n’atamfo di yie;
na ne mmarato dodoɔ nti
AWURADE ahyɛ no awerɛhoɔ.
Ne mmotafowa adi ɔtamfoɔ anim
kɔ nnommumfa mu.
6Na Sion babaa ahokeka nyinaa
afiri ne ho kɔ;
ne mmapɔmma ayɛ sɛ atwe
a wɔnnya adidibea,
na wɔadwane atifoɔ anim
a wɔnni ahoɔden.
7 # Lew 26.34-35 Yerusalem amaneɛ ne n’ahometeɛ nna yi mu
wakae n’afɛfɛdeɛ
a na ɛwɔ hɔ firi
tete nna mu no nyinaa;
ne nkurɔfoɔ hwee ɔhohiahiafoɔ nsam
na wannya ɔboafoɔ biara no,
n’ahohiahiafoɔ ani gyee,
na wɔseree no n’ahweaseɛ mu.
8 # Kwa 1.17; Yer 13.22 Bɔne kɛseɛ na Yerusalem ayɛ,
ɛno nti na wadane akyiwadeɛ.
Wɔn a anka wɔdi no ni nyinaa bu no animtiaa,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔahunu n’adagya;
ɔno nso gu ahome,
na wadane n’ani.
9Ne ho figuo akeka n’atadeɛ mmuano mu;
wankae n’awieeɛ,
enti na wabrɛ ase ama no ayɛ nwanwa;
ɔnni ɔwerɛkyekyefoɔ biara.
O AWURADE, hwɛ m’amaneɛ,
ɛfiri sɛ, ɔtamfoɔ adi nkonim!
10 # Deut 23.3 Ɔhohiahiafoɔ no atene ne nsa
n’afɛfɛdeɛ nyinaa so,
aane wahunu amanaman,
sɛ wɔrehyɛne ne kronkronbea hɔ,
nnipa a wohyɛɛ sɛ
wɔnnhyɛne w’asafo mu no.
Sion kwadwom ne n’adesrɛ
11Ne nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa gu ahome
hwehwɛ aduane;
wɔde wɔn afɛfɛdeɛ ma gye aduane
de hyɛ wɔn ho den.
O AWURADE, hwɛ na hunu;
na wɔbu me animtiaa!
12 # Kwa 1.5 Ɛmfa mo a mofa ɔkwan so twam nyinaa ho bi?
Monhwɛ na monhunu
sɛ ɔyea bi wɔ hɔ a ɛte sɛ me yea,
a aka me yi,
a AWURADE de aho me werɛ
n’abufuhyeɛ da no!
13Wama ogya firi soro;
aduru me nnompe mu, na adidi mu;
wasum me nan fidie,
wama masane m’akyi.
Wama mayɛ pasaa,
meyɛ hodwoo daa nyinaa.
14Ɔde ne nsa akyekyere
me mmaratodeɛ ayɛ no kɔnnua;
ɛtoatoa mu gu me kɔn mu,
wama m’ahoɔden asa,
AWURADE ayi me ahyɛ wɔn
a mentumi nnyina wɔn anim no nsa,
15 # Yes 63.3 AWURADE ato m’akunini
a ɛwɔ me mu nyinaa agu.
Ɔfrɛɛ nnipa dɔm maa wɔhyiaa mu tiaa me,
sɛ wɔnnwerɛ me mmeranteɛ;
AWURADE atiatia Yuda babaa so
sɛdeɛ wɔtiatia nsa-kyi-amena mu.
16 # Yer 9.1 Yeinom nti na mesu.
M’aniwa kyi nisuo gu fam,
ɛfiri sɛ me werɛkyekyefoɔ a
ɔbɛdwodwo me kra ne me ntam ware;
me mma ayɛ pasaa,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔtamfoɔ adi nim.
17 # Kwa 1.8 Sion atrɛ ne nsam,
nanso ɔnni ɔwerɛkyekyefoɔ biara.
AWURADE ahyɛ no Yakob ho sɛ
wɔn a atwa ne ho ahyia nyɛ n’ahohiahiafoɔ;
Yerusalem adane
wɔn mu afideɛ.
18 # Kwa 3.42; 5.16 AWURADE di bem,
ɛfiri sɛ me na mate n’anomu asɛm ho atua.
Aman nyinaa, montie,
na monhwɛ me yea.
Me mmabaa ne me mmeranteɛ
kɔ nnommumfa mu.
19 # Kwa 1.11 Mefrɛɛ m’adɔfo,
nanso wɔdaadaa me;
na m’asɔfoɔ ne me mpanimfoɔ
repɛ aduane
de ahyɛ wɔn ho den no,
wɔtotɔɔ piti kuro no mu.
20AWURADE, hwɛ sɛ me ho hiahia me yi,
m’ayamdeɛ kyinkyim,
m’akoma adane wɔ me yam,
ɛfiri sɛ mate atua kɛseɛ nti.
Afena twitwa me mma abɔntene so,
na ewuo nso wɔ fie.
21 # Kwa 4.21 Wɔte sɛ meresi apini,
nanso menni ɔwerɛkyekyefoɔ;
m’atamfoɔ nyinaa ate m’amaneɛ;
wɔn ho sɛpɛ wɔn sɛ woayɛ me saa;
wobɛma ɛda a woahyɛ no adu,
na wɔn nso ayɛ sɛ me.
22Ma wɔn nnebɔne nyinaa mmra w’anim,
na yɛ wɔn
sɛdeɛ me mmaratodeɛ nyinaa
nti wɔyɛɛ me no;
na m’apinisie adɔɔso,
na m’akoma atɔ piti.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
